(Update: 2/19/2026):
Ive honestly changed my mind about this game. It hasnt changed, but I have. I learned that the challenge of the game kept pulling me back, because its the difficulty in life that makes it so special. If we had everything easy, life would be boring. 

I want to personally appoligize to the devs for the negative review. And say that I finally "Got Gud". Im very happy with the challenge of the game. And the amount of hours ive sunk into it proves that I cant stay away, no matter how mad it makes me. It also helped me with my anger issues, which I really value. If a video game can help you overcome real life issues just by playing it, Its more valuable than any price tag. $40 is far to little for an experience like this. 


Old review:

Basically useless as a single player game, small enemies one shot you and half the bosses have forever respawning small enemies in the arena. Unless you have 1 or 2 friends to play with I would not recommend this as randoms are really bad at the game.

They need to fix the balencing for solo. Otherwise its pretty good in co-op, but that shouldnt be the only option.
